_comment: AWS-F2 refresh of networks_mlp10_dronet20_yolov8_firesim_static_q31profile.json. Identical workload (mlp_control @10ms x16, dronet @20ms x8, one-shot yolov8_nano) but retargeted at profile target 'firesim_f2_rocket_saturn': per-dispatch times measured on the f2_dual_small_norose_tacit_q31_60mhz bitstream with the CURRENT modelblaster codegen. The original spec's 'firesim_rocket_saturn' profiles date from Jun 2026 and were captured against an older IR (dronet 30 dispatches, yolov8_nano 212); today's extract_graph fuses bn/conv/relu and emits 21 / 155, so those schedules can no longer be ingested into a harness built from this tree. Dispatch graphs here are emitted by modelblaster.pipeline.emit_dispatch_graph from the same graph.json the harness links.
